scripts.test:app: npm run build -w @money-kids/functions && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,functions --project money-kids-test "npm test -w @money-kids/app"
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w @money-kids/functions && firebase emulators:start --only firestore,auth,functions,storage --project money-kids-test
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @money-kids/functions && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,functions,storage --project money-kids-test "npx playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts"
